summary: Chemomab Therapeutics, an Israeli foreign private issuer, filed a 6-K reporting Amendment No. 1 to its July 7, 2026 domestication and merger agreement with Scipher Medicine. The amendment adds a formula-based exchange ratio so the combined entity, renamed Scipher Medicine Corporation, will have exactly 10,000,000 shares outstanding post-closing; it explicitly leaves consideration, economic value, and the Chemomab/Scipher ownership split unchanged and also addresses fractional shares, equity-award substitution, and CVRs. Closing is expected in Q4 2026, with Nasdaq listing under SCIP and Reginald Seeto as CEO. Watch regulatory clearances, shareholder votes, and any further ratio adjustments as risk-arb milestones.
